source.name: Sideload Apps
source.subtitle: Auto-updating source combining several sideloadable apps
source.description: Generated every 3 hours by GitHub Actions. Each app comes from its developer's own source or GitHub releases; nothing is re-hosted.

apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: YouTube with SponsorBlock, downloads and more
apps.localizedDescription:
YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS with SponsorBlock, background playback, player controls, and interface customization.

Note: the version shown is the bundled YouTube version, not YTKACE's.
